description: Header file defining a template-based Type-Length-Value (TLV) data structure with Request, Response, and Buffer classes, as well as a message exchange class for handling communication with synchronization and data serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: Template struct implementing TLV data handling with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: Template class managing message exchange with synchronization, data serialization, and communication handling.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes TLV data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into TLV structure.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another Request object if types match.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next TLV block in the buffer.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the buffer to process contained TLV data.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns reference to the communication channel.
